batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c KB Arun Karthik b DL Vettori

batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: run out (M Kaif, AB de Villiers)

batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b DL Vettori

batting.name: BJ Hodge
batting.dismissal: c Z Khan b S Aravind

batting.name: RA Jadeja
batting.dismissal: c M Kaif b A Mithun

batting.name: RV Gomez
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b S Aravind

batting.name: R Vinay Kumar
batting.dismissal: c DL Vettori b Z Khan

balls.text: full toss, hit hard down the ground, and Tiwary makes a diving save at long-off, saving two runs
makes room, hits this down to long-off for one

RP is gone too. Lazy running, this was like he had come for an evening jog in the park. Powar looks for the scoop, ends up hitting his own pad, the ricochet goes to the right of the keeper, and RP is lethargic in taking the single. AB, as usual, is superb, and hits then stumps direct

and another one bites the dust. Jadeja makes room, heaves, gets a thick edge, Kaif comes in running from sweeper-cover, shouts mine loud and clear, fending off Gayle and Vettori, and makes the catch low in front of him
yorker, hit down to long-off for one
driven past extra cover and they come back for two
makes room and drives this towards extra cover where Kaif makes a diving save
the knuckle slower ball, runs this down to short third for one, and unnecessary direct hit allows an overthrow. Gayle apologises
makes room, hits it into the leg side, gets just the single
Vinay Kumar is gone. He has no choice but to go for the big hits. Gets too under this length ball, and Vettori completes the catch at mid-off
swinging into Jadeja, hits him on the pad, but they sneak in a leg-bye
heave away, gets an inside edge, and surprisingly a fumble from Kohli in the deep on the on side
comes down the track, gets a single to long-off
gets an inside edge onto the pad as he looks to drive, and Jadeja forces him into the single
Vinay plays this with soft hands into the leg side where all the fielders are on the boundary, and charges back for the second. He is a smart and aware cricketer, always
slower ball, just turns too far down the leg side
driven on the up, gets a single to sweeper-cover
slower ball, Gomez didn't have many options but to hit out as he looked out of his depth, and Kohli makes this catch to his right at long-on look simpler than it is
length ball, hit back, makes a diving save to his left
seems like a wide down the leg side but it has clipped the pad on the way
tucks him up with one into the ribs, concedes just the single
gets bat on ball this time, but can't beat the diving Kohli at point
similar delivery again, cramping him up, skidding it through, beats an attempt to late-cut this time
that's quick and skiddy, beats Jadeja's attempt at a cut, too close to the body too
starts with a slower ball, and single towards short third man
slightly slower this time, opens the face, gets the single to wide of point
quicker, fuller, around off, defended back to him
slower through the air, pushed to cover point
and bowls quick and flat too, a semi-edge-semi-late-cut goes for four just as fast
nicely tossed up, middle and leg, defended back to Vettori
full on the pads, flicked away for one
paddle-sweep, straight to short fine leg, Bangalore are rushing through their overs
defended back to the bowler
leading edge, goes back uppishly, but doesn't carry to Dilshan
cut away this time, gets just the single
nicely pulled away by Jadeja towards deep midwicket. Kohli makes a big dive running from long-on, but cannot prevent the boundary
another wide down the leg side, and they run the extra too
short outside off, hit down to long-off for one
slower offcutter, pitches outside off, leaves him, beating the bat, superb over - one run and one wicket
stays around off again, defended to cover
this seems to have held its line outside off, beating a defensive poke

Zaheer has plucked a mango here, and it is mango season too in India. Just about. This was pulled seemingly for four over short fine leg, until Zaheer leapt full length, and stuck his left hand out. Lovely catch
back of a length, pretty straight, no room, hit back to the bowler
hit to the right of extra cover for one
tossed up outside off, driven past the diving straight extra cover
full and straight, hit back to Gayle again
cut away after making room, Kochi need more of this
wide too far down the leg side
helped away into the leg side for one
Gayle is loving this, this time with a diving save to his left to save a single

if you are really uncharitable, you could call this this a missed stumping. Gayle saw Hodge come down the track, slipped this in full, beat the bat, and difficult as it is to spot when somebody is hitting over the top of the ball, it also kicked off from a full length. No chance for AB
full toss, flicked to midwicket for one
punched away square for a single
steered away to third man, and Kaif runs to his right to keep them down to one
angled across Jadeja, who gets a thick edge to third man
comes down the track, is cramped up by a short delivery, runs this down to third man
gets his line right now, back of a length, just outside off, defended
and resumes with a wide down the leg side
and Hodge is edgy, he is desperate to get off the mark. This time he drops it to leg and charges off. Jadeja, though, makes it this time as there is no indecision in the running
looks to turn this to leg, the ball hits the front edge, and comes back to Gayle
pushed down the ground for one
short and quick, jammed into the ground

and whoa what a crazy run-out pulled off by ABD. Take a bow AB de Villiers! He didn't need to do this, but he has done it. What drama between Hodge and Patel too. Back from start. Hodge cuts it to short third and charges off right away. Patel, whose call it should be, says no after a bit, and both start going to the non-striker's end. de Villiers meanwhile doesn't know that this is an easy chance, and gets this wild throw, collects it diving to his left, and in the same motion flicks it onto the stumps even as he is going down. To make it more dramatic, there is a photo finish as to who is closer to the non-striker's out and should stay back. Replays show Patel has lost by inches
cut away to sweeper-cover

DannyV bowls a peach here, and Mahela looks at the pitch as if it is somebody who has let him down. This is flatter, quicker, pitched outside off, just short of driving length, Mahela looks to push it into the off side, gets a thin edge as the ball turns sharply and kisses the edge on the way to de Villiers. And by the way - not that there is anything wrong with not walking - Mahela is not a walker, unlike many believe him to be
nicely flighted, around off and thereabouts, Mahela defends
straighter one, worked away off the pads for one
short, turning away, cut in front of square
big front foot down the ground, slog-sweep, along the ground, gets a single
full delivery, pushed down to long-off for one
another yorker, hit back to Gayle
pushed down to long-on to get off the mark
Gayle is winning this battle of wides hands down. This pitches leg, Mahela sneaks himself inside the line, and let sit turn down the leg side
Gayle is obviously looking to cramp him up, but he has bowled it down the leg side again
wide down the leg side
hit to the right of Gayle who gets in front of Parthiv and fields, and then wraps an arm around Patel to seemingly apologise. Doesn't look like it
full, on the pads, played straight to midwicket

yorked him, bowled him! Gayle is loving this. Klinger looks to charge at him, Gayle bowls this right on the crease, and takes the middle stump out. And what an ever-lasting smile Gayle has on his face. And his team-mates are enjoying this too. Although he doesn't dance this time
comes down the track, hits to the left of straight midwicket, where Dilshan makes a diving save
flat, cut away to short third man for a single
shimmies down the track, Vettori tosses it up higher, Klinger defends it back
opens the face towards point and steals one
tossed up on middle and off, driven back to Vettori
another whip, lovely turn of the wrists, beats short fine leg, and Zaheer Khan - perhaps aware of the perils of the Bangalore outfield - doesn't put in the dive
whipped away off the pads, finds square leg
another dab to third man for one
dropped to square leg for a single
cut away, Dilshan makes a diving save at point
opens the face on this to get a single to third man
short down the leg side, Patel gets enough bat on this to send it wide of the keeper

Caught off a no-ball. This one stopped a bit, lobbed to short midwicket. And what is this poor awareness of cricket laws? This is the second time in this IPL somebody has broken stumps when a batsman is walking off dismissed off a no-ball. That just won't earn you a run-out, boys. He doesn't know it is a no-ball, and is walking back in good faith, and not even trying a run. Aleem Dar has to remind Bangalore of that
back of a length outside off, runs this down to third man
nicely played, very quick footwork. Patel presses forward, sees this is a bit short, and quickly transfers the weight back to cut this for four
worked off the pads again, gets another single
works this off the pads to get off the mark

Vettori wins over fellow Kiwi. He is a shrewd bowler. McCullum charges at him again, Vettori refuses to push it through, instead bowling it slightly short and slightly wide, MCCullum is beaten in the flight and ends up spooning this to short third man
flighted nicely again, clipped away off the pads, wide of deep backward square leg
Mcullum charges at Vettori first ball. Vettori stays slow through the air, McCullum is early into the shot, gets an inside edge that saves him from the stumping
quick, into the pads, defended

that's a bad fall, and I have always felt that the Bangalore outfield is the worst in the country. It is a superb ground otherwise, and can throw up good wickets and crowds, but the bumpy outfield is the most dangerous for a fielder. There is a stretcher coming out for Pujara. I hope this doesn't cost him months, he had just about started to cement a place in the Test side. So this is what happened. McCullum drive it through extra cover, first Dilshan made a diving save at the fence, his knee bounced off the outfield as he did so. Pujara, who followed him to the fence, hurt his knee as he went down for the slide. Now, though, he says no to the stretcher, and walks back on his own two feet
wide down the leg side
another four, does well to recover after an early charge. This becomes a highish full toss, but he chips it over Gayle's head
near yorker outside off, beats him
well played again, charged at him, made room too, took this on the full, and drove it past point
full and fastish, stays back and defends
angled across him, pushed to short cover
well played and well fielded, Klinger runs this down fine, Vettori  - bad knee and all - makes a diving save at short third man, but he knocks it a touch too far and concedes the second
swept away powerfully, one bounce to deep square leg
stays back of a length, tucks him up
another delivery too straight, could have been four past short fine again, but the extra bounce means he is hit on the thigh pad. They take a leg-bye
craftily done, this was back of a length, cramping him up a bit, and he glances it wide of short fine leg
McCullum is electirc in stealing this single as Klinger just drops this towards point, and McCullum calls him through and makes it to the danger end
pulls the length back a bit, more towards middle than leg, defended
loose ball, and accepted with gratitude by Klinger. Full on the pads with short fine leg up. Four runs
slower ball, opens the face on it, and they steal a single to cover-point
BMac is feeling it. Charges at Zaheer this time, and - it's not the best shot you will see - somehow manages to get it over midwicket. Cramped he was on this shot
straight, worked around the corner for one
tries another one, but this time Arvind bowls it a bit wide, and McCullum slogs as opposed to the previous straight hit. No connection made
Baz has arrived to the ground where he scored 158 three years ago. Dances down the track and lofts this length ball over mid-off. Bring it on BMac
seam movement away from just outs outside off, beats McCullum's poke
charges at him, this goes off the inside half of the bat towards deep square leg
back of a length, decent bounce into the chest, defended
full outside off, slight movement away with the angle, left alone
on the pads this time, and he helps it away for an easy single
Klinger forces the issue here, makes an early forward movement, converts it into driving length, and lofts it straight over Zaheer's head
stays in the similar zone outside off, just short of driving length, pushed to cover
pulls the length back a bit, played straight to point
full on the pads, clipped to deep backward square
full, angled across him, pushed wide of mid-off
beautiful shot to finish this massacre here, Kohli gets right on his toes, rides the bounce and punches this between mid-off and extra cover
driven down the ground for a single
flighted around middle and off, defended
pushed into the on side, all fielders on the boundary, and they come back for the second
punched away to short extra cover
swept away powerfully for a single
crashed away to deep point, a fumble from PP allows them to come back for two. Fifty for Dilshan
full and wide, driven straight to mid-off - PP's economy rate has falled drastically from 37 to 20
pulled away from outside off, to mid-on
length, around off, pushed to cover
short and wide again, another single
cut away to deep point for one
and already his economy rate has come down from 37 to 31.62 as he beats him outside off
quick, into the pads, can't get it off the square
quick and flat, played back to the bowler
flighted around off, pushed for a single to cover
into the pads, helped around the corner
flat and quick, hit back to Jadeja
good shot, goooood shot, inside out from leg-stump line, over extra cover
shimmies down the track, pushes this down to long-on for one
short and flat, cut to sweeper-cover for one
lovely shot, proper cricketing shot, coming down the track, getting close to the pitch of the ball, driving it past extra cover, all along the ground
pulled away, one bounce to deep midwicket
straighter one, hit straight to mid-off
flat, punched away into the off side
cut away to point
driven inside-out, for a single to long-off
fired into the pads, concedes the leg-bye
opens the face on this, can't get it past point
driven past extra cover this time, comes back for two
short and wide, cut away for four
comes forward to push this to cover
and Kohli proves his brief is not to make sure that all time-outs are taken. Cuts this 10 metres to the left of deep point, but it is hit so hard that he has no chance to prevent the boundary
this is slightly fuller, but what the hell, Dilshan still cuts it, gets just the single, though
just short of a length, but Dilshan is deep in the crease to make this into a cutting length, past point
drops and runs, gets the single before point can come in
punched away off the back foot, can't beat cover
slower through the air, and short too, Dilshan rocks back to cut this past the slip
another quick and straight delivery, played back to Jadeja
the quicker one, cramps Dilshan up
drives inside-out, finds short extra cover
driven past Jadeja for a single to long-off
and a huge lbw shout first ball, pretty close to, the straighter one, pitches off and middle, goes with the arm, hits Kohli in font of leg. Sliding down
lovely shot, this is short, on top of off, Dilshan leans back a little, waits a little, opens the face a little, and cuts this very very fine
pulls awkwardly from in front of his face, somehow keeps it down, gets the single
back of a length, around off, heavy ball, the ball hitting the bat as opposed to the other way
nicely worked away off the pads, Parmeswaran has to make a diving save at deep midwicket
length ball, middle and leg, hit to mid-on. Boring
angled into the pads, misses out on the flick
flicked away uppishly into vacant space square on the on side
stays low to beat his attempted pull, Dilshan gets the leg-bye
gets a single wide of mid-on
wide down the leg side, even though RP and Parthiv appealed incessantly for a catch. The noise seems to have come from the thigh pad
angled across him, stays back and pushes this to cover
worked away off the hips for one
cut away, but straight to cover-point
left alone outside off. Seriously? You are following Gayle. Can't shoulder arms and all

and Malinga has bowled. Oops it's Vinay Kumar. What a lovely little moment, against a red-hot Gayle. Vinay goes round the stumps, and stops in his delivery stride to go round arm, slinging this full and straight, beating Gayle and taking the off stump out
slower bouncer, another dot
Gayle gives a chance, hitting it hard towards mid-off, but it doesn't carry even though Powar makes a dive in front of him. Good effort
extra bounce here as he cuts this, but they manage the single
stop the press. No boundary. Dot ball in fact. Punched straight to cover-point
inside edge, but that too goes wide of the keeper for four. This is robbery in day light. Bangalore are demolishing Kochi. In case you didn't notice, 37 runs came off this over
Where do you hide when Dilshan and Gayle are going like this? He is toying around with them. Comes down the track and goes straight this time. 91 metres. Over the sight screen
Carnage. Gayle makes room, wallops a length ball over cover. He has taken this Go Green campaign seriously, and will finish this before flood lights can come on

Mahela said at the toss he had plans for Gayle. Right. The plan seems to have four to five men on the off-side circle and bowl back of a length. PP does just does that, and he punches it between extra cover and cover. Sweet as
Short ball, at this gentle pace, murdered past midwicket
this is ridiculous. Demolition. Slower ball, in his swinging arc, and he lofts it over point again. What's more? It's a no-ball
Sorry, it's Gayle who is into the attack, makes room, gets under a length ball, opens the face, and clears point easily
Annihilation, thy name is Dilshan and Gayle. This time Dilshan takes on the deep on-side field, charging down the track, hitting this over wide long-on, back into the second tier
and Dilshan is exploiting the prone off side, comes down the track and goes inside-out, over mid-off. One bounce for four
and Dilshan makes room to punch him square on the off side, where Jadeja dives full length to save four runs
short ball, pulled away wide of deep midwicket
We might not see all the time-outs today, what a loss of revenue! Dilshan comes down the track, and lofts this over mid-on, even though the bottom hand comes off the handle
oh this is double-barrel attack. Dilshan sweeps the first ball he faces for four. No attempt to keep it down, up an over square leg

Christopher Henry Gayle has announce today's flight. "InterGalyeatic" says the big screen. Just a casual step down the green, just a casual extension of the arms into the shot, and the ball is on the second tier behind long-off. Not an element of uncouthness about that shot
Gayle is warming up, hits this on the up, hard, towards mid-off
clipped away off the hips, wide of midwicket, comes back for two
bouncer, Gayle coolly lets it sail over his head for a wide
back of a length, punched back to RP
comes down the track and swings straight, but is beaten by the short ball
slight threat to swing it away, Gayle defends
